name: openpixo/cel-anime
title: Cel-shaded anime
description: Clean linework, graphic shadows and vibrant accents for expressive game characters.

description_i18n.en: Clean linework, graphic shadows and vibrant accents for expressive game characters.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 以干净线稿、块面阴影与鲜明点色，表现富有表情的游戏角色。

examples.title: Sky courier
examples.prompt: Generate an original sky courier character using the cel-anime art style: cropped blue jacket, practical shoulder bag and a folded paper glider. Use a neutral three-quarter pose and clear cel shadows.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 cel-anime 美术风格生成一名原创天空信使：短款蓝夹克、实用单肩包和折叠纸滑翔机。采用自然的四分之三姿态，阴影块面清晰。

examples.title: Element badges
examples.prompt: Create four matching elemental ability badges using the cel-anime art style: wind, ember, frost and thunder. Use bold silhouettes, clean outlines and one hard-edged shadow band.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 cel-anime 美术风格制作四枚配套的元素能力徽章：风、余烬、冰霜和雷电。使用醒目轮廓、干净描边和一层硬边阴影。

style.prompt: Original cel-shaded game illustration with confident clean linework, expressive but balanced proportions and broad graphic color shapes. Use one clear hard-edged shadow band, a small highlight band and controlled accent colors from the shared palette. Keep costume details organized into readable groups, consistent line weight and a neutral three-quarter presentation.
style.negativePrompt: photorealism, painterly smudging, heavy gradients, excessive rim light, glossy plastic skin, tangled costume details, inconsistent line weights, text, logo, watermark

constraints.outline: Clean tapered dark linework; interior lines lighter than the silhouette.
